name: orange-mysterious-girl-profile
image_vibe: Mysterious modern art portrait, vivid orange, motion-blurred film softness
image_purpose: Create a medium editorial profile portrait with dynamic panning movement.

prompt.project_info: A cinematic editorial profile portrait of an original adult woman in a minimal orange studio.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with dark-brown short wind-blown hair, soft natural skin tone, calm serious mysterious mood, and a side-profile gaze looking into the distance. She wears a dark minimal coat or jacket with a high collar.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium side-profile portrait with head slightly turned forward, solid vivid-orange backdrop, clean minimalist studio, and horizontal panning motion blur in hair/background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio light with cinematic contrast, subtle glow, smooth shadow gradients, matte faded film treatment, and soft grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-resolution portrait, side-profile camera angle, panning motion effect, controlled horizontal blur, cinematic color grading, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic medium cinematic editorial profile portrait of an original adult woman with dark-brown short wind-blown hair, soft natural skin tone, and a calm serious mysterious expression looking forward into the distance. She wears a dark minimal high-collar coat or jacket. Set her against a solid vivid-orange studio background with soft diffused light, cinematic contrast, subtle glow, smooth shadow gradients, horizontal panning motion blur in hair and background, matte faded film treatment, soft grain, and modern artistic atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, sexualized pose, celebrity likeness, distorted profile, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, excessive blur, watermark, text, deformed

assets.name: source orange profile reference
assets.usage: Use only for profile composition, orange backdrop, hair motion, coat styling, and film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult woman, dark short hair, high-collar coat, orange studio, side profile, panning blur, and mysterious editorial mood. Identity and non-essential studio details may vary.

changes: Clarified an original adult subject and added age/identity exclusions.
